name: The Viridescent Hunt
passiveDesc: Upon hit, Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to generate a Cyclone, which will continuously attract surrounding opponents, dealing 40/50/60/70/80% of ATK as DMG to these opponents every 0.5s for 4s. This effect can only occur once every 14/13/12/11/10s.

skills.label: Verdant Wind — Cyclone damage per tick
